data.gender_notes: Ashyansh is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ashyansh is derived from two Sanskrit words - 'ashyana' meaning 'seat' and 'ansh' meaning 'part'. The name signifies a noble and valiant being, someone who holds an important position or power. The name Ashyansh carries the meaning “Noble, Valiant” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Ashyansh usually hope their child will grow to embody noble, valiant and live with faith, good character and purpose.
